### System information

- **Exact command to reproduce**: n/a
@zheng-xq Can you take a look at this?

It will be very helpful to have a small repro case.

CPU and GPU are known to produce slightly different results. For each operation, if the inputs are identical, the output should only have lsb difference. So if you observe large difference from a single operation, not a sequence of operations, it might be a bug somewhere. Otherwise, this is somewhat expected.
@annemenini Can you provide code + data to reproduce this?

I unfortunately cannot share the full code and do not manage to reproduce to problem in a simple unit test so far.

To clarify, the difference I observe out of a single operation (tf.multiply) is significant: with the notation A .* B = C, here are the values I observe on one randomly picked element of the tensor:

On CPU:
A = -0.2314 + 0.2525i
B = -0.0212 - 0.3013i
**C = 0.0810 + 0.0644i**

On GPU:
A = -0.2314 + 0.2525i
B = -0.0212 - 0.3013i
**C = -0.0712 + 0.0751i**

The mismatch disappears when the same operation is executed on its own in a simpler graph (hence why I don't manage to reproduce the problem in a unit test).
